---
name: Decision for Mark
about: A major design decision that waits on Mark. Raise one only if it blocks work, changes an approved design, or touches more than one session or branch.
labels: decision
title: "Decision: "
---

## Question

The question that Mark answers by picking an option.

## Context

Two or three lines: what is true now, and why it needs an answer.

## Options

- A: what it is and what it changes
- B: what it is and what it changes

## Recommendation

A: why

## Docs

One line for each doc section that this concerns. The heading id is lower case, with a hyphen between words.

- path#heading

## Raised by

The session, the branch or the PR.

## Waits on this

What stops until Mark answers.
